write_up: This is a strong FP&A resume: your work at Lakeshore Foods connects a division budget with forecasting, pricing and conversations with finance and brand leaders. A recruiter can see both the work you own and the numbers that matter.

The forecast line is a model for the rest: it names what you built and shows the error rate before and after. Your earlier Power BI automation also makes its benefit easy to understand. Experience leads Education, and your current role is easy to find.

Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a call back. For a more senior move, add a budgeting decision you made across the division if you can substantiate one. The competition for the role will matter too.
